content.name: Marie Schulz
content.title: Junior Business Analyst
content.summary: Junior business analyst at a Frankfurt logistics company with a B.Sc. in Business Informatics from Goethe-Universität and ten months as a working student in a bank's payments team. Hold the IREB CPRE Foundation Level certificate and enjoy translating between operations staff and developers. Work comfortably in German and English.

experience.title: Junior Business Analyst
bullets: Documented warehouse returns processes at two sites and drafted 45 requirements for a new returns module in the warehouse management system.
Analysed scanner error logs and proposed label format changes that lowered mis-scans by about 18%.
Prepare sprint review notes in German and English for a mixed team of eight in Frankfurt and Poznań.

experience.title: Working Student, Business Analysis (Werkstudentin)
bullets: Supported the payments team during SEPA Instant Credit Transfer preparation by maintaining the requirements backlog in Jira.
Compared current and target processes for payment returns and summarised gaps for the product owner.
Built Excel reports on test progress that the project lead used in weekly steering meetings.

education.details: Grade 2.0. Bachelor thesis: requirements quality in agile banking projects.

courses.name: IREB Certified Professional for Requirements Engineering (CPRE) Foundation Level

achievements.title: Case competition
achievements.detail: Second place in a university process improvement case challenge (2023).

achievements.title: Student council
achievements.detail: Represented business informatics students on the faculty council for two years.

interests: Volunteering at a refugee language café
